description: Realizable-vs-theoretical edge check against live CLOB order-book depth — AND Polymarket's own taker fee, which is never zero and is folded in rather than left for you to add (fleet #3446: r/PredictionsMarkets flagged a "clean" fill that quietly omitted it as optimistic in the direction that loses money). REQUIRES one of `market` (single-market mode) or `event` (basket/partition mode). SINGLE-MARKET: pass a market slug/URL + side (buy_yes|sell_yes|buy_no|sell_no, default buy_yes) + size_usd (default 1000 — max spend on buys, target proceeds on sells); walks the ladder and returns top_of_book, vwap_fill_price, slippage_pp, shares_filled, max_fillable_usd, verdict (clean|degraded|cannot_fill), fee_schedule ({category, taker_rate, exponent, maker_rebate_rate, fees_enabled, basis} — read off THIS market, never assumed free), fee_usd/fee_pp at the actual VWAP fill, breakeven_win_rate_taker (the win probability your side needs just to cover price + fee — ~51.8% on a 50c crypto taker fill, not 50%), breakeven_win_rate_maker (no fee charged to makers — any rebate is in fee_schedule.maker_rebate_rate), and all_in_cost_pp = slippage_pp + fee_pp. BASKET: pass an event slug/URL + side (sell_yes = capture overround by selling every leg, buy_yes = capture underround; default auto from partition sum) + size_usd interpreted as settlement notional S (shares per leg; each share pays $1); returns theoretical_sum vs realizable_sum (top-of-book vs VWAP across all legs), capture_ratio and profit_usd — both NET of every leg's own Polymarket taker fee (capture_ratio_gross/profit_usd_gross keep the pre-fee figures; per_leg[].fee_usd itemizes each leg, summed as fees_usd_total), per-leg fill detail, thin_legs[], max_clean_notional_usd, and forced_directional_risk naming the legs most likely to strand you unhedged. USE THIS before acting on any polymarket_arbitrage SELL/BUY-EVERY-LEG signal or any polymarket_edges trade above ~$500 — theoretical overround on thin books is not capturable, and partial basket fills convert an arb into an unhedged directional position (the dominant loss mode in real arb-bot P&L). Adverse selection while working resting orders is still not modeled.

event.description: Basket mode: event slug or full polymarket.com URL — checks every leg of the partition.

market.description: Single-market mode: market slug or full polymarket.com URL.

side.description: Single-market: buy_yes | sell_yes | buy_no | sell_no (default buy_yes). Basket: sell_yes | buy_yes (default auto — sell if partition sum > 1, buy if < 1).

size_usd.description: Single-market: USD to spend (buys) or target proceeds (sells). Basket: settlement notional — shares per leg, each paying $1 at resolution. Default 1000, clamp 10–1,000,000.

name: polymarket_fill_risk

outputSchema.description: Realizable fill risk against live order-book depth, plus Polymarket's own taker fee and the breakeven win-rate it implies (fleet #3446).

_hint.description: Usage note — what is gross vs net of fees, and what is still unmodeled.

all_in_cost_pp.description: Single-market mode: slippage_pp + fee_pp — the full round-trip cost of this fill.

book_levels_visible.description: Single-market mode: count of price levels on the side priced.

breakeven_win_rate_maker.description: Single-market mode: win-rate a maker (no taker fee charged) would need — equals top_of_book.

breakeven_win_rate_taker.description: Single-market mode: win-rate (0-1) the filled side needs to break even as a taker, INCLUDING the fee — always worse than the raw fill price.

capture_ratio.description: Basket mode: fraction of the theoretical edge that survives depth AND fees (fleet #3446 — was gross of fees before).

capture_ratio_gross.description: Basket mode: the pre-fee figure capture_ratio used to report.

dead_legs.description: Basket mode: leg slugs with zero visible depth on the priced side.

error.description: Error code (orderbook_unavailable, event_books_unavailable, empty_book, bad_side, missing_input) — present only on failure.

fee_pp.description: Single-market mode: the taker fee as a percentage point of a $1 share — size-invariant, so it's the same number at any trade size.

fee_schedule.description: Polymarket's published taker-fee parameters for this market, read off the market payload (fleet #3446) — never assumed fee-free.

basis.description: Where the rate came from — payload (read off this market) is the most trustworthy.

exponent.description: Exponent in fee = shares × rate × (p×(1-p))^exponent — 1 on every market observed.

fees_enabled.description: false means this market genuinely charges no taker fee.

maker_rebate_rate.description: Polymarket's published maker rebate rate, when known.

taker_rate.description: Taker-fee rate actually applied (0 means genuinely fee-free, never "unknown").

fee_usd.description: Single-market mode: Polymarket taker fee in USD on the shares actually filled.

forced_directional_risk.description: Basket mode: plain-English risk note naming dead/thin legs.

leg_count.description: Basket mode: number of legs priced.

max_fillable_usd.description: Single-market mode: total USD value of the entire visible side of the book.

message.description: Human-readable error detail — present only on failure.

mode.description: Which mode answered — set by which of market/event was passed.

partition_complete.description: Basket mode: false means truncated_legs > 0 — edge figures are directional only.

fee_usd.description: This leg's own Polymarket taker fee in USD at the executed size.

realizable_at_executed_size.description: Basket mode: VWAP sum across all legs at the executed size, net of each leg's own Polymarket taker fee (fleet #3446 — profit_usd was gross before).

fees_usd_total.description: Sum of per_leg[].fee_usd across every leg.

note.description: Present only when the basket is not executable at any size.

profit_usd.description: NET of every leg's own Polymarket taker fee.

profit_usd_gross.description: Before fees — kept alongside profit_usd so the fee cost is never hidden.

reasoning.description: Plain-English explanation of the verdict, naming the all-in cost and breakeven.

scaled_down_by_thinnest_leg.description: Basket mode: true if executed size was capped below the requested size.

settlement_notional_executed_usd.description: Basket mode: shares-per-leg actually executable, scaled down by the thinnest leg.

settlement_notional_requested_usd.description: Basket mode: requested shares-per-leg (the size_usd argument).

shares_filled.description: Single-market mode: shares actually fillable from visible depth.

side.description: Single-market mode: the side actually priced (buy_yes|sell_yes|buy_no|sell_no).

side_auto_selected.description: Basket mode: true if side was inferred from the partition sum rather than passed explicitly.

size_usd_requested.description: Single-market mode: the size_usd argument, clamped.

slippage_pp.description: Single-market mode: |vwap - top_of_book| in percentage points.

strategy.description: Basket mode: which side was priced across every leg.

theoretical.description: Basket mode: top-of-book sum across all legs, before depth.

thin_legs.description: Basket mode: leg slugs that cannot cleanly absorb the requested size.

top_of_book.description: Single-market mode: best price on the side priced.

truncated_legs.description: Basket mode: legs dropped by the 80-leg cap, if any.

usd_filled.description: Single-market mode: dollars actually fillable from visible depth.

verdict.description: Single-market mode: fill-quality verdict based on depth/slippage (independent of the fee).

vwap_fill_price.description: Single-market mode: volume-weighted fill price across the requested size; null if nothing filled.

title: Polymarket Fill Risk
